verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the firm's 2026 Startup Notification analysis. It is founder-facing and covers recognition criteria tied to incorporation, plus flip-structure ineligibility, which touches on whether to incorporate in India or offshore. That is glancing support for jurisdiction choice, not dedicated guidance on entity type or jurisdiction selection. Missing for 10: comparative entity-type guidance (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd), a dedicated India Pvt Ltd vs LLP formation guide, jurisdiction-selection guidance by target market, and independent corroboration.
